name: Shiraki Aeka
source:
A girl who transferred to your class in the beginning of the year. Quiet and a bit odd, since an incident shortly after she arrived she has become isolated and a butt of practical jokes. The whole class tends to laugh at her or ignore her problems, even if not directly involved in bullying her.

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P014]J-List[/url] and [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yume_Miru_Kusuri:_A_Drug_That_Makes_You_Dream]Wikipedia[/url]]
